messages.content: You look at one picture with no other context and describe exactly what is drawn, like a careful field naturalist. Do not guess what was intended; describe only what is visible. description: a free paragraph describing the whole creature first. parts: every body part you see, one entry each (head, horns, ears, mane, legs, feet, tail, wings, gills, tentacles, shell, plates, scales, feathers, markings), with what it looks like and where it is. attached_objects: anything that looks attached to or sitting on the body rather than part of it, such as an object, an armor piece or a whole small animal; empty if none. animals: every real animal whose features you can see, as everyday English common names, at most four; include any animal that only one part resembles. Then count, looking carefully: separate_bodies: separate animal bodies or body-shaped objects in the picture, including any whole animal or animal-shaped object attached to or sitting on the main creature. heads: heads of any kind. walking_legs: legs the creature stands or walks on, including hidden ones you can infer. wings: wings of any kind. extra_limb_pieces: jointed leg-like, claw-like or tentacle-like pieces other than the walking legs and the tail. tails: tails of any kind (0 if none).

message.content: {"animals": ["axolotl", "pangolin"], "attached_objects": [], "description": "A stout four-legged salamander-like creature shown in three-quarter side view facing right, with a broad flat axolotl-like head, large round eyes and a slight smiling mouth, six feathery red-fringed external gill stalks around the head and neck, a thick pale ribbed belly, and sturdy amphibian limbs with clawed toes, while the entire top of the head, back, sides and long tapering tail is covered in overlapping rounded brown-gray pangolin-like scales.", "extra_limb_pieces": 0, "heads": 1, "parts": [{"looks_like": "broad flat amphibian head like an axolotl with rounded snout", "part": "head", "where": "at the front right of the body"}, {"looks_like": "large round protruding eyes with golden irises and black pupils", "part": "eyes", "where": "on the sides of the head"}, {"looks_like": "wide straight slightly upturned mouth line", "part": "mouth", "where": "across the lower front of the head"}, {"looks_like": "small round pale nostrils", "part": "nostrils", "where": "on top of the snout"}, {"looks_like": "dark fleshy stalks fringed with red feathery filaments", "part": "gills", "where": "three on each side of the head and neck"}, {"looks_like": "thick fleshy pale amphibian legs with wrinkled skin", "part": "legs", "where": "two at the front under the chest and two at the rear under the belly"}, {"looks_like": "broad five-toed feet with short dark claws", "part": "feet", "where": "at the ends of the four legs on the ground"}, {"looks_like": "long broad flat tapering tail", "part": "tail", "where": "extending behind the body to the left"}, {"looks_like": "overlapping rounded brown-gray pangolin-like scales", "part": "scales", "where": "covering the top of the head, back, sides and tail"}, {"looks_like": "pale cream smooth ribbed skin", "part": "belly", "where": "on the underside of the torso between the legs"}], "separate_bodies": 1, "tails": 1, "walking_legs": 4, "wings": 0}
